bitcoin_articles.headline: WisdomTree Research Releases Bitcoin Outlook for 2027
bitcoin_articles.summary: WisdomTree's digital assets research team has published an analysis outlining the key drivers for Bitcoin in 2027, including macroeconomic conditions and investor demand.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Transfers $318.36 Million in BTC and ETH to Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has executed a transfer of approximately $318.36 million in Bitcoin and Ethereum to the Coinbase exchange.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Completes Sale of Remaining Bitcoin Reserves
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data announced the sale of its remaining Bitcoin holdings, totaling approximately 211.56 BTC, for proceeds of roughly $16 million.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Nakamoto Inc. Subsidiary BTC Inc. and Metaplanet Announce Launch of 'Bitcoin Japan' Conference
bitcoin_articles.summary: Nakamoto Inc.'s subsidiary, BTC Inc., has partnered with Metaplanet Inc. to launch 'Bitcoin Japan,' a new flagship conference scheduled for February 2028 in Tokyo.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Standard Chartered Expands Digital Assets Prime Brokerage Partnership with 24X
bitcoin_articles.summary: Standard Chartered has expanded its partnership with 24X Bermuda Limited to include digital assets prime brokerage, enabling institutional trading in Bitcoin and Ethereum.
